verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains extensive documentation of Bevy's ECS, rendering, audio, UI, animation, and scene systems, but nowhere mentions rigid-body physics, collision detection, or raycasting as built-in engine features — these are known to be provided by third-party crates (e.g., bevy_rapier, avian) rather than Bevy core. No first-party or community evidence claims physics works out of the box.
